Name of Test Case: Block unauthorized visitor access to welcome queue
Action to Take: Navigate to '#/guests/welcome' as an unauthenticated public visitor.
Expected Outcome: Welcome queue is hidden; displays 'StaffOnly' notice prompting staff sign-in.

Name of Test Case: Display arrived guests queue for signed-in staff
Action to Take: Sign in as staff and open '#/guests/welcome'.
Expected Outcome: Displays WelcomeQueue component showing waiting list and planned guests list.

Name of Test Case: Persist host staff name in local storage
Action to Take: Type host name 'Brother David' into 'Your name' field and reload page.
Expected Outcome: Host name 'Brother David' is saved to localStorage and restored on reload.

Name of Test Case: Claim an arrived guest from waiting queue
Action to Take: Click 'I’ll meet them' button on a waiting guest card.
Expected Outcome: Calls POST /visits/:id/claim with hostName; marks guest as claimed by Brother David.

Action to Take: Click 'Welcomed' checkmark button on a claimed guest card.
Expected Outcome: Calls PATCH /visits/:id with status 'welcomed'; removes guest from active waiting list.

Name of Test Case: Display accurate party size and host preference tags
Action to Take: Inspect waiting guest card for party of 4 who prefers not to be met.
Expected Outcome: Card displays 'Party of 4' badge and muted notice 'Prefers not to be met at door'.

Action to Take: Observe waiting guest card for guest who arrived 6 minutes ago.
Expected Outcome: Displays elapsed waiting counter 'Arrived 6m ago' updating periodically.

Name of Test Case: Real-time queue polling updates without refresh
Action to Take: Keep Welcome Team screen open while a new guest checks in on another device.
Expected Outcome: Background 5-second interval poll detects new arrival and adds card to queue with arrival chime/alert.

Name of Test Case: Browser arrival push notifications on mobile browsers (iOS / Android)
Action to Take: Tap 'Enable arrival notifications' on iOS Safari or mobile web browser.
Expected Outcome: Native browser arrival push notifications fire when guest arrives.

Name of Test Case: Concurrent guest claim race condition between two hosts
Action to Take: Two welcome hosts click 'I’ll meet them' on the same arrived guest card within 1 second.
Expected Outcome: Optimistic concurrency lock notifies second host that guest was already claimed by another team member.
